playerHit.speaker: monster
lines: Ow! That was my good ear!
Rude. Effective, but rude.
I felt that one in my lunch.
Hey! I was standing there!
That's going to leave a story.

playerMiss.speaker: player
lines: I meant to hit the wall. It had it coming.
Warm-up swing. Obviously.
The air is now very well cut.
That would have been incredible.
Fine. The {monster} gets one.

crit.speaker: monster
lines: Okay. Okay. That one was good.
Something in me just resigned.
I'd like to file a complaint.
I saw my whole life. It was mostly caves.
Was that legal? That didn't feel legal.

goblinHit.speaker: monster
lines: Got you! Write that down!
Ha! Stabbed it!
That's for the cave tax.
Mine now. Mostly the blood.
Did that hurt? Say it hurt.

goblinMiss.speaker: monster
lines: Stand still, I'm aiming!
Practice swing. Totally practice.
The rock moved. Not my fault.
Next one, for real.
I was told this would be easier.

dodge.speaker: monster
lines: *The {monster} hops sideways, grinning like it planned this.
Duck, weave, mostly duck.
Not today, tall thing.
I am made of elbows and caution.
Too slow! Probably!

block.speaker: monster
lines: Where do you think you're going?
Exit's closed. Management.
Nobody leaves before the fun.
Door's this way. Through me.
Sit back down.

lowHp.speaker: self
lines: Just a scratch. Several scratches.
I'd like to pause this, please.
Everything is fine and also bleeding.
I've had worse. I think. Can't remember.
Is it cold in here, or is it me?

defeat.speaker: loser
lines: Tell the others I was tall.
I'll just lie here and reflect.
This is fine. Lying down is fine.
Remember me as undefeated, mostly.
I regret everything. Mostly the cave.

fleeSuccess.speaker: player
lines: Tactical retreat! Very tactical!
I'll be back. Much later.
Running is a kind of strategy.
Goodbye forever, or until floor two.
Legs, do the thing!

fleeFailed.speaker: monster
lines: Nope. Stay.
Leaving so soon? We just met.
Not that way. Or any way.
Sit. Good. Now, where were we?
The tunnel says no.

circling.label: Circling
circling.line: It circles you, looking for an opening. Likely to counter.

wary.label: Wary
wary.line: It keeps its distance. Likely to dodge.

braced.label: Braced
braced.line: Feet planted. If you run, it will try to block you.

notes: Lines starting with * are narration and show as an italic caption instead of speech. {player} and {monster} are filled in. speaker: player, monster, self (whoever is low on HP), loser (whoever was defeated).
